profile.description: 这是一个非物理的软件通信组件，用于通过 socketcand 服务连接和操作 CAN 总线。它主要用于实验系统中的 CAN 消息发送与连接关闭，不直接代表某一台具体仪器。
profile.description_en: This is a non-physical software communication component used to connect to and operate a CAN bus through the socketcand service. It is mainly used in lab systems for CAN message transmission and connection shutdown, rather than representing a specific physical instrument.
